description: Wind Speed across Singapore is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by National Environment Agency. Minute-by-minute wind speed readings at weather-station level, updated every five minutes. These data are collected from automated weather instruments, and is automatically published as soon as it is generated. There could be instances when there are gaps in the data due to technical problems. The data is subject to correction subsequently if necessary. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher National Environment Agency. It offers 1 resource(s) in api. The portal shows 2025-12-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
